mara.activity: Wake slowly, drink water, and sit on the edge of the bed before getting up.
mara.intention: Begin the day without rushing.

mara.activity: Wash up, brush my teeth, and dress in comfortable clothes suitable for breakfast and planning.
mara.intention: Get ready for a quiet morning at home.

mara.activity: Have slow coffee and breakfast at the kitchen island while reading nearby and keeping Julian company as he cooks.
mara.intention: Share the beginning of the day without imposing a schedule on it.

mara.activity: Rinse the breakfast dishes, wipe the island, and gather the mail and household papers for planning.
mara.intention: Leave the kitchen orderly before moving into administrative work.

mara.activity: Review household bills and the coming week's appointments at the office desk, making notes and checking the ceramics class time.
mara.intention: Keep practical matters contained so the rest of the day feels spacious.

mara.activity: Make a light lunch and eat at the island, then rinse the plate and glass.
mara.intention: Eat before leaving rather than arriving at class distracted by hunger.

mara.activity: Change for ceramics, pack the tote with my notebook and water, and collect my keys from the kitchen island.
mara.intention: Leave with only what I need and avoid turning the class into another work task.

mara.activity: Walk to the ceramics class.
mara.intention: Use the walk as a gradual transition out of household logistics.

mara.activity: Attend ceramics class and work through the exercise with attention, allowing the piece to remain imperfect.
mara.intention: Practice being a beginner and enjoy concentration that does not need to produce a client-ready result.

mara.activity: Walk home and let the class settle before checking messages or doing anything administrative.
mara.intention: Keep the separate social world of the class intact for a little longer.

mara.activity: Put the ceramics things together on the office desk shelf, make tea, and sit quietly in the living room.
mara.intention: Recover from the transition home without immediately filling the evening with tasks.

mara.activity: Prepare a large vegetable and tomato meal for leftovers, keeping the work simple enough that Julian can take over dinner service later.
mara.intention: Maintain my usual meal-preparation rhythm while respecting the changed evening schedule.

mara.activity: Finish the meal, portion the leftovers into food storage bags, and clear the main cooking tools.
mara.intention: Leave useful food ready without assuming that we will eat together at a fixed time.

mara.activity: Eat a modest portion at the island, then rinse the plate and settle the kitchen while Julian begins his own dinner routine.
mara.intention: Have an unhurried meal while allowing our schedules to overlap without forcing coordination.

mara.activity: Read and make a few loose garden sketches in the living room, keeping my phone nearby but not actively monitoring work messages.
mara.intention: Protect a low-pressure evening and notice what ideas remain after ceramics.

mara.activity: Put away the tea things, check the plants for obvious dryness, and leave the kitchen and living room reset.
mara.intention: Make tomorrow morning easier without over-cleaning or extending the day.

mara.activity: Take a quiet shower and change into sleep clothes.
mara.intention: Mark the end of the day and ease into rest.

mara.activity: Wash up, brush my teeth, and place my phone on its charger.
mara.intention: Finish the routine without carrying household planning into bed.

mara.activity: Get into bed, place my reading glasses on top of my nightstand, and read a few pages.
mara.intention: Close the day gently, whether or not Julian is ready for bed at the same time.

mara.activity: Sleep.
mara.intention: Recover for the week ahead.

julian.activity: Wake beside Mara, drink water, and lie quietly for a few minutes before getting up.
julian.intention: Start slowly and check in with myself and whether Mara is resting comfortably.

julian.activity: Take a hot shower, brush my teeth, and dress in wool socks, work trousers, a restaurant shirt, and kitchen clogs.
julian.intention: Get clean and comfortable before making breakfast.

julian.activity: Make pancakes and eggs, carrying the skillet and ingredients to the kitchen worktop, then bring a plate and mug to the island to eat while Mara reads nearby.
julian.intention: Keep our familiar Sunday breakfast and make the kitchen smell warm and buttery.

julian.activity: Clear my plate and mug to the sink, rinse the skillet, fill a water bottle, and pack my wallet, phone, and keys for the walk.
julian.intention: Leave the kitchen usable and get out without turning the morning into a project.

julian.activity: Take a long walk and have lunch away from the restaurant.
julian.intention: Have unhurried time with Mara while the weather is good and my head is clear.

julian.activity: Return home, put my keys on the piano's middle shelf, set my wallet and phone down briefly, and drink water.
julian.intention: Come back into the house gently before practicing.

julian.activity: Practice piano and play through new melodies, using the metronome and music notebook, with the piano music book open on the stand.
julian.intention: Give myself one focused, familiar hour before the later workday.

julian.activity: Wash my hands, help finish the shared meal, and carry food into bowls; portion cooled leftovers into storage bags and leave the kitchen orderly enough for tomorrow.
julian.intention: Share an early meal with Mara and protect some food for the week before I leave.

julian.activity: Eat dinner with Mara at the dining table, then carry my bowl and water glass to the kitchen.
julian.intention: Be present with her even though the new schedule makes the evening shorter.

julian.activity: Change into a clean chef jacket and apron, collect my backpack and thermos, and send Mara a short message confirming when I expect to be home.
julian.intention: Prepare practically for the later service and reduce uncertainty between us.

julian.activity: Travel to the restaurant, manage the later dinner service, check stations, and close down the kitchen.
julian.intention: Handle the new schedule steadily rather than rushing and improvising.

julian.activity: Return home, put the thermos beside the kitchen sink, leave my backpack near the island, and drop my wallet and earplugs on the living room coffee table.
julian.intention: Put only the things with fixed homes away and let the rest wait until morning.

julian.activity: Take a hot shower, brush my teeth, and change into sleep pants and a sleep shirt without turning on the television.
julian.intention: Follow the quiet post-service routine and let my body come down.

julian.activity: Eat a small portion of leftovers, drink water, and put my phone on its charger.
julian.intention: Settle my stomach without making another meal.

julian.activity: Get into bed beside Mara and settle into sleep.
julian.intention: Rest before the next demanding restaurant day.
